notes: The ASV compresses בַּמַּעֲלוֹת אֲשֶׁר into 'by which', so the preposition and relative each take a word and the intervening article and noun go unrepresented under rule 22; 'ten steps' answers to עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת and 'the dial' to the construct מַעֲלוֹת אָחָז.
The margin's literal gloss 'Hebrew steps' corroborates the 'dial' rendering and decides nothing, by rule 38.
